reports.title: Jack Henry & Associates, Inc. Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Full year fiscal 2027 guidance (Dollars in millions, other than per share amounts):3

Revenue | $2,698 | $2,718

Monett, MO, November 3, 2026 - Jack Henry & Associates, Inc. (Nasdaq: JKHY), a leading financial technology provider, today announced results for fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2026.

According to Greg Adelson, President and CEO, “We continued our positive momentum in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, delivering record financial results that exceeded the outlook we provided in August. The demand environment remains very strong, as reflected in our outstanding sales performance and robust pipeline. We are extremely pleased with the start of our fiscal year and based on improved revenue drivers, we again exceeded consensus expectations. We are confident in our ability to continue delivering consistent, long-term results through an unwavering commitment to culture, service, innovation, strategy, and execution.”
